There are 4 pages in total. Saradomin page 3 is a members-only item with a 4-hour buy limit of 5 and a high alchemy value of 120 coins. Over the last 30 days the price of Saradomin page 3 has risen 9.8%, ranging from 301 to 13,891 gp.
